205729|a83f1be8.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|a83f1be8.text: $N, my would-be protege. I'm afraid there is nothing more I can teach you. Perhaps our paths will cross again someday.

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

6361-progress.name: Devrak
6361-progress.text: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
6361-progress.title: A Bundle of Hides

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

759-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-progress.text: $N.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
759-progress.title: Wildmane Totem

76156-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-progress.text: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $c. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-progress.text: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, $c. Even skin contact could be quite painful.
76160-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76240-complete.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76240-complete.text:
That was quite a display, $c. Although unfortunately, not the rogueish precision I hoped for.

I see now that you will not be the one to carry my legacy in the subtle arts, but you may take this as a parting gift. Good luck on your travels, $c. The Horde will need heroes like you.
76240-complete.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76240-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76240-progress.text: Do you have something for me?
76240-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

784-progress.name: Gar'Thok
784-progress.text:
You have your orders, $N. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.

Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.
784-progress.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

861-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
861-progress.text: Greetings.  There is an air about you that tells me much.  Do we have business, you and I?
861-progress.title: The Hunter's Way

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests
